statements.statement: Town manager laid out the FY25 budget calendar: target budgets out before Christmas, forecast and capital plan week of Jan 15, preliminary budget week of Feb 12, town meeting May 4.
Health insurance expected to rise up to about 10% for FY25, affecting both school and town sides.

warnings.prediction: School committee faces a budget challenge for FY25 from loss of ESSER and a health insurance increase.
warnings.who: a member reporting on the school committee
